The main takeaway from our work is that
the natural history of vestibular schwannoma is highly variable, with a subset of patients experiencing significant tumor growth over time and others with no growth at all.
a change in tumor volume correlates with a change in audiometric function.
patients with vestibular schwannoma who are initially classified as class D (i.e. have a pure-tone average of >50 dB) are at a greater risk of hearing loss than patients with class A or class C.
